open_points.subject: A18 backup/write concurrency
open_points.text: “Its read transaction and the store's writes do not wait for each other” does not define whether it forbids only waiting for the other operation to finish or also brief database-lock contention while the snapshot boundary is established.
open_points.question: What observable blocking, if any, is allowed when a store write and the backup snapshot begin concurrently?
options: Neither operation may be delayed by a lock held for the other, even briefly.
Brief coordination or lock waiting is allowed, provided neither operation waits for the other operation to finish.
Only an unbounded wait or a surfaced busy/timeout failure is forbidden.
open_points.default_guess: Allow only brief coordination needed to establish the snapshot; never wait for the backup run to finish and never surface contention as a refusal or failure.

witness.initial: Registry is running normally; no backup transaction or store write is active just before 03:00 UTC.
events: The backup run begins and starts establishing its read snapshot.
At the same time, the owner submits a project correction whose store transaction is ready to commit.
outcomes: The correction commits without any database-lock delay; if its commit is after the snapshot boundary, the backup excludes it.
The correction waits briefly for snapshot establishment, then commits while the rest of the backup continues; the backup excludes it.
witness.observer: The owner or a latency/concurrency test sees whether the correction is delayed by the backup.
